decision_rationale: Enforce shared factual constraints before either preference ranking.
Estimate data-driven preference from neighboring users' observed ratings, with target-user holdout and minimum support.

intent: Verify reproducibility, factual constraints, evidence requirements, and examples before delivery.

decision_rationale: Test boundary values, missing facts, conflicting risk signals, invalid numbers, and ambiguous identities.
Change observed ratings to verify a data-driven ranking response.
Check target-user exclusion, minimum support, stable ties, and input preservation.
Report holdout coverage alongside error so abstention remains visible.
Align tests with the finalized no_evidence API status after an initial naming mismatch.

synthetic_holdout.protocol: leave_one_user_out; eligibility gated; supported predictions only
limitations: Coverage and MAE must be read together; abstained rows are not scored.
Sparse, selected ratings do not represent all users or unseen products.
Preference error does not measure suitability, financial benefit, or fairness.
Default samples are fictional; these metrics are only a mechanics check.
No chronological backtest is possible without interaction timestamps.

output.remaining_work: Inspect accessible actual workbook, verify field/unit mapping, rerun real-data recommendations and validation.

risk_check: Synthetic evaluation is a mechanics check. Source-workbook import and production financial validation remain unverified.
